     --tree-card-background-current-unfocused: light-dark(
       color-mix(in srgb, var(--layout-background-0) 98%, var(--color-gray-50)),
-      color-mix(in srgb, var(--layout-background-0) 88%, var(--color-gray-90))
+      color-mix(in srgb, var(--layout-background-0) 88%, var(--color-gray-50))

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical dark-theme fix changed the unfocused card mix colors. Current accepted CSS uses newer light-dark mixes with layout-background-3, so its old gray-50 percentages are not current constants. It retains distinct current, selected, selected-current and unfocused tokens, and selects the unfocused family under :not(:focus, :focus-within). Preserve state separation when changing card colors. Forced-colors has separate system-color tokens. No visual or contrast check ran.
title: Use separate card-state tokens for focused and unfocused selection
